name: M3_PPS170MI_GetPlannedPO
description: Retrieve a single planned purchase order by its internal planned order number and return full header and line details. The operation reads an existing planned purchase order created by planning or integrations such as Multi Site Planner and exposes information about facility, warehouse, item, dates, quantities, status, prices, supplier, and references. Use it when an external process or report needs the complete content of one specific planned purchase order.

inputParameters.name: PLPN
inputParameters.description: Internal number identifying the planned purchase order to retrieve.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number for which the planned purchase order is retrieved.

inputParameters.name: PLPS
inputParameters.description: Subnumber identifying the specific part of the planned purchase order to retrieve.

inputParameters.name: PLP2
inputParameters.description: Secondary subnumber used to further identify the planned purchase order instance to retrieve.

outputParameters.name: CONO
outputParameters.description: Company number for the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: FACI
outputParameters.description: Facility responsible for the warehouse and planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: WHLO
outputParameters.description: Warehouse where the planned purchase order applies.

outputParameters.name: ITNO
outputParameters.description: Item number on the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PLPN
outputParameters.description: Internal number of the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PLPS
outputParameters.description: Subnumber identifying a specific part or line of the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PLP2
outputParameters.description: Secondary subnumber for further identification of the planned purchase order instance.

outputParameters.name: GETY
outputParameters.description: Code indicating how the planned purchase order was originally created, for example from a manufacturing or customer order or Multi-Site Planner.

outputParameters.name: PRIF
outputParameters.description: Planning priority value showing how many days remain before the order must be released to avoid a shortage. A negative value means the release date has already passed.

outputParameters.name: RPLQ
outputParameters.description: Quantity of the item that is short according to the material plan for this planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: RELD
outputParameters.description: Planned release date when the planned purchase order should be converted into an actual purchase order.

outputParameters.name: DLDT
outputParameters.description: Planned delivery date for the goods on the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PLDT
outputParameters.description: Planning date when the planned purchase order affects the material plan.

outputParameters.name: FUDT
outputParameters.description: Optional follow-up date used to monitor or review this planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PPQT
outputParameters.description: Planned purchase quantity for the item on the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: RESP
outputParameters.description: User ID responsible for the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: BUYE
outputParameters.description: Buyer responsible for the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PUSL
outputParameters.description: Lowest purchase order status used when selecting or updating related purchase orders for this planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PURC
outputParameters.description: User who requested or requisitioned the items on the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: RFID
outputParameters.description: Reference ID linking the planned purchase order to a record in the reference file, such as a purchase, delivery receipt or claim reference.

outputParameters.name: YRE1
outputParameters.description: Contact person at the supplier to be contacted regarding this planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: AURE
outputParameters.description: Authorized user connected to this planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: ORTY
outputParameters.description: Purchase order type controlling how the planned purchase order will be processed when released.

outputParameters.name: POTC
outputParameters.description: Purchase order category indicating the overall type of purchase order, such as normal, consignment or subcontract.

outputParameters.name: RORN
outputParameters.description: Reference order number, such as a customer, project or manufacturing order, linked to the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: RORL
outputParameters.description: Line number on the reference order linked to the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: RORX
outputParameters.description: Line suffix on the reference order line linked to the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: RORC
outputParameters.description: Order category of the reference order linked to the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: OSHV
outputParameters.description: Ship-via address through which the goods are routed before reaching the final destination.

outputParameters.name: OFID
outputParameters.description: Final delivery address for the goods on the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: TEDL
outputParameters.description: Delivery terms agreed with the supplier for this planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: MODL
outputParameters.description: Delivery method to be used for this planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: TEPY
outputParameters.description: Payment terms controlling how the due date is calculated for this planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PRIP
outputParameters.description: Priority value used to rank this planned purchase order in processing or reporting.

outputParameters.name: SUNO
outputParameters.description: Supplier number for the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PUNO
outputParameters.description: Purchase order number associated with the planned purchase order, if a purchase order has been created.

outputParameters.name: CUCD
outputParameters.description: Currency code used for the purchase price on the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PITD
outputParameters.description: Item name as printed on the purchase order for this planned purchase order line.

outputParameters.name: PITT
outputParameters.description: Item description as printed on the purchase order for this planned purchase order line.

outputParameters.name: PUPR
outputParameters.description: Purchase price per purchase price unit for the item on the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PPUN
outputParameters.description: Unit of measure in which the purchase price for the planned purchase order is expressed.

outputParameters.name: PUUN
outputParameters.description: Purchase order unit of measure used for the quantity on the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PUCD
outputParameters.description: Quantity that the purchase price applies to when calculating the price per unit.

outputParameters.name: PTCD
outputParameters.description: Code for a text to print instead of the numeric purchase price on the purchase order.

outputParameters.name: ODI1
outputParameters.description: First discount percentage applied to the planned purchase order line.

outputParameters.name: ODI2
outputParameters.description: Second discount percentage applied to the planned purchase order line.

outputParameters.name: ODI3
outputParameters.description: Third discount percentage applied to the planned purchase order line.

outputParameters.name: PROD
outputParameters.description: Manufacturer of the item on the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PACT
outputParameters.description: Packaging ID used for the goods on this planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: GRMT
outputParameters.description: Goods receiving method controlling how receipt and inspection of the planned purchase order are processed.

outputParameters.name: ADVI
outputParameters.description: Via address through which the goods are shipped before reaching the final destination.

outputParameters.name: WHL1
outputParameters.description: Warehouse used as an additional selection key for this planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: OSH1
outputParameters.description: Additional via address used as an intermediate delivery point for the shipment.

outputParameters.name: BANO
outputParameters.description: Lot number for the item on the planned purchase order, when lot-controlled.

outputParameters.name: APRB
outputParameters.description: User who approved the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: RSCD
outputParameters.description: Reason code explaining why this planned purchase order transaction was entered or changed.

outputParameters.name: LOCD
outputParameters.description: Local currency code used as the company’s base currency.

outputParameters.name: CUPR
outputParameters.description: Purchase price converted to the local currency for this planned purchase order line.

outputParameters.name: PSTS
outputParameters.description: Status code of the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: ACRF
outputParameters.description: User-defined accounting control object used to influence account entries for this planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: COCE
outputParameters.description: Cost center to which the costs of the planned purchase order are attributed.

outputParameters.name: IRCV
outputParameters.description: Recipient of the ordered item, printed on goods receipt and put-away documents.

outputParameters.name: SITE
outputParameters.description: Item number used by the supplier for this item on the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PTXT
outputParameters.description: Internal note text for this planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: TEOR
outputParameters.description: Indicator that the order was placed by telephone to avoid sending duplicate written orders.

outputParameters.name: ATNR
outputParameters.description: Attribute number used for configured items on the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: TRQT
outputParameters.description: Transaction quantity in the item's basic unit of measure for the planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: UNMS
outputParameters.description: Basic unit of measure in which inventory for the item is managed.

outputParameters.name: RGDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the planned purchase order record was created.

outputParameters.name: RGTM
outputParameters.description: Time when the planned purchase order record was created.

outputParameters.name: PDLN
outputParameters.description: Product line for the item used to group similar items for purchase planning.

outputParameters.name: OURR
outputParameters.description: Internal reference number connected to the planned purchase order, such as an agreement or inquiry number.

outputParameters.name: OURT
outputParameters.description: Type of internal reference number used on the planned purchase order, such as agreement or inquiry number.

outputParameters.name: SCHN
outputParameters.description: Schedule number linking the planned purchase order to a specific production or delivery schedule.

outputParameters.name: MUFT
outputParameters.description: Indicator controlling whether additional cost processing is triggered for this planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: PORG
outputParameters.description: Purchase organization used for purchase pricing or planning of this planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: KITI
outputParameters.description: Indicator specifying whether the item on the planned purchase order is a kit.

outputParameters.name: KITQ
outputParameters.description: Number of components per kit included on this planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: TOCQ
outputParameters.description: Total number of kit components included on this planned purchase order line.

outputParameters.name: COUM
outputParameters.description: Unit of measure used for expressing kit component quantities on this planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: LMDT
outputParameters.description: Date when the planned purchase order record was last changed.

outputParameters.name: CHID
outputParameters.description: User ID of the person who last changed the planned purchase order record.

outputParameters.name: SRAM
outputParameters.description: Supplier rebate agreement model applied to this planned purchase order.

outputParameters.name: SRGR
outputParameters.description: Indicator whether this item contributes to supplier rebate generating or paying totals.
